game.title: METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN

roadmap.title: Start recruiting and build the early buddies
roadmap.description: Complete the opening story through Mission 14. Recruit D-Dog and Quiet, extract soldiers, and start development and key dispatches as soon as they appear. Mark enemies and collect invoices during travel.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and build buddy bonds
roadmap.description: Progress through both chapters and complete the yellow Side Ops and tapes. Rotate buddies until their bonds are full. Start FOB infiltration after Mission 22, and earn Hero before developing a nuclear weapon.

roadmap.title: Finish Mother Base and Side Ops
roadmap.description: Expand the seven Mother Base categories to four platforms each. Improve every team, finish the key dispatch chain and Side Ops, and hand the memento photos to Paz.

roadmap.title: Replay missions and finish collections
roadmap.description: Finish harder mission variants and optional tasks. Make separate fast runs for S ranks when needed. Use the animal, blueprint, key-item, and invoice checklists to close the remaining gaps.

roadmap.title: Develop and dispose of a nuclear weapon
roadmap.description: Reserve the processed materials for a nuclear weapon and extra GMP for disposal. Watch the displayed timer and dispose of the completed weapon promptly.

achievements.summary: Finish Mission 45, A Quiet Exit.

steps.text: Reach maximum bond with @npc{Quiet}, finish Mission 43, and remove the @item{Butterfly} front from your emblem if equipped. Complete the yellow story Side Ops until @mechanic{Side Op 150: Secure Quiet} appears.

Read the intel file inside the barracks at @loc{Afghanistan Guard Post 4} during Side Op 150. This starts Mission 45 immediately; prepare a strong rocket launcher and @item{Battle Dress} before starting the Side Op.
Defend Quiet at @loc{Lamar Khaate Palace}. Destroy the tanks, armored vehicles, and final gunship; request ammunition drops when needed. Finish the escape sequence.

achievements.description: Finish Mission 46, Truth: The Man Who Sold the World.
achievements.summary: Finish Mission 46, Truth: The Man Who Sold the World.

steps.text: Finish the normal story missions, complete the yellow story Side Ops, and listen to every yellow cassette tape. Harder repeat missions and Mission 45 are not required to make Mission 46 appear.
Return to @loc{Mother Base} for pending story scenes, then select @mechanic{Mission 46: Truth: The Man Who Sold the World} and finish the hospital escape.

achievements.description: Complete a mission using a Combat Unit staff member.
achievements.summary: Finish a main mission while playing as a Combat Unit soldier.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Mission 8} to unlock the Combat Unit. On the sortie screen, use @mechanic{Select Character} to choose a Combat Unit soldier instead of Snake, then complete a short main mission such as Mission 3.

achievements.summary: Finish every main mission, including the harder repeat missions.

steps.text: Complete the main mission list from @mechanic{Mission 0} through @mechanic{Mission 50}, including the Extreme, Subsistence, and Total Stealth variants.
For Mission 45, finish Side Op 150 with Quiet’s bond full and the Butterfly emblem front removed. For Mission 46, finish the normal missions and yellow Side Ops, and listen to the yellow tapes.

achievements.summary: Complete every task in all main missions.

guide.context: After finishing a mission once, inspect its task list in the iDroid mission menu. Complete the main objective as well as the extra tasks below. Tasks can be collected over separate completed runs, and harder variants have separate task lists. For late cleanup, bring D-Dog, the wormhole Fulton, and the upgrade that allows child extraction. Listen with the INT-SCOPE; alerts can stop scripted conversations. For a container escape, stand on the container and hold the prompted grab control as the Fulton lifts.

collectibles.name: Mission 0: Awakening
collectibles.location: Hospital and horseback escape.
collectibles.method: Finish without triggering Reflex Mode; disable Reflex in the settings before starting. During the horseback chase, shoot the Man on Fire with the shotgun whenever the aiming reticle turns red. Avoid every attack after meeting Ocelot; restart the checkpoint if hit.

collectibles.name: Mission 1: Phantom Limbs
collectibles.location: Spugmay Keep, Da Wialo Kallai, Wakh Sind Barracks, and Da Ghwandai Khar.
collectibles.method: Climb the cracked cliff to the right of the opening tutorial for the diamond. Extract the truck driver at the northern road junction of Da Wialo Kallai and the red-bereted commander in Wakh Sind’s northern compound. Read intel or interrogate a guard to pinpoint Miller, then rescue Miller. Change the helicopter landing zone to the northern landing zone by Guard Post 11 to avoid the Skulls.

collectibles.name: Mission 2: Diamond Dogs
collectibles.location: Mother Base tutorial.
collectibles.method: Finish Ocelot’s Fulton, recruitment, and cardboard-box training. Stay after Ocelot says you may leave. Wait for the CQC instructions, restrain and choke a staff member, then Fulton the staff member. Finish the strike training by knocking out another staff member with punches and extracting the staff member.

collectibles.name: Mission 3: A Hero’s Way
collectibles.location: Da Shago Kallai and the desert north of Guard Post 25.
collectibles.method: Pick the northwestern Haoma in the desert south of the landing zone north of Guard Post 25. Collect the materials beneath the village end of Da Shago’s western concrete bridge, by the first support. Tranquilize the red-bereted commander from at least 100 meters away, then extract the commander.

collectibles.name: Mission 4: C2W
collectibles.location: Da Wialo Kallai and Eastern Communications Post.
collectibles.method: Rescue the two prisoners in the ruined building reached from Da Wialo’s southern entrance. On the southern approach to the communications post, climb the small rock west of the dirt-road bend opposite the Wormwood for the diamonds. Mark the communications dishes before destroying them. Destroy the transmitter inside the building beside the Soviet flag and extract one materials container.

collectibles.name: Mission 5: Over the Fence
collectibles.location: Wakh Sind Barracks.
collectibles.method: Start east of the barracks and intercept the four-wheel drive arriving from the south; extract the vehicle. Rescue the escaped prisoner behind a rock above the main entrance arch. Collect UN-ARC from the upper-left dormitory in the group of six. Carry the engineer under the basement ceiling hole, put the engineer down, and use a balloon Fulton through the hole rather than the wormhole.

collectibles.name: Mission 6: Where Do the Bees Sleep?
collectibles.location: Mountain Relay Base and Da Smasei Laman.
collectibles.method: Extract both snipers at the Mountain Relay Base and rescue the mute prisoner before the prisoner leaves, or follow the transport to the ruins. Destroy the patrolling gunship. Collect the Honey Bee, defeat all four Skulls with other weapons, and leave without firing any Honey Bee ammunition.

collectibles.name: Mission 7: Red Brass
collectibles.location: Da Ghwandai Khar and Da Wialo Kallai.
collectibles.method: Rescue the prisoners in Da Ghwandai’s headquarters basement and northern building. At Da Wialo, listen to the entire three-commander meeting in the building across the street east of headquarters before intervening. Extract the three commanders and the soldiers who arrived in a commander’s vehicle. Mark the arriving escorts; if unsure which soldiers rode with the commander, extract the soldiers around the meeting building.

collectibles.name: Mission 8: Occupation Forces
collectibles.location: Qarya Sakhra Ee and the convoy road toward Da Smasei Laman.
collectibles.method: Interrogate a guard to mark the deployment plans and collect the plans. Rescue the prisoner in the room with the communications transmitter. Stop the convoy before Da Smasei Laman with a roadblock or EMN mines. Extract both tanks and the colonel’s truck, keeping the colonel alive for extraction.

collectibles.name: Mission 9: Backup, Back Down
collectibles.location: Northern roads, Wakh Sind Barracks, and Lamar Khaate Palace.
collectibles.method: Use separate vehicle and prisoner runs. For vehicles, block the road near the landing zone north of Yakho Oboo with a truck facing south. Stop all seven armored vehicles without resupply or fire support; Fulton at least one. Collect the weapon from the passing transport truck. After all seven are stopped, stay for the reinforcements and extract all three tanks. For prisoners, start south of Guard Post 12 and rescue the nearby wanderer, then stop two armored vehicles to trigger the prisoner transport. Extract the four searching soldiers on the canyon path east of Guard Post 12 and the escaping prisoner ahead of them. Intercept the four-wheel drive carrying a prisoner from Aabe Shifap Ruins toward Wakh Sind. Rescue the prisoner in Wakh Sind’s basement and the prisoner in a cell north of Lamar Khaate Palace. For the final prisoner, follow the river west from the bridge north of Guard Post 12 to the dead end beside the log jam.

collectibles.name: Mission 10: Angel with Broken Wings
collectibles.location: Lamar Khaate Palace and Yakho Oboo Supply Outpost.
collectibles.method: First, stop Malak’s convoy at the palace and extract the escort armored vehicle. Rescue the three palace prisoners before execution: one in the outside cell, one on the second floor, and one on the third floor. On another run, let Malak’s transport reach Yakho Oboo. Listen to the driver’s final conversation with Malak from outside the southwestern compound wall. Rescue Malak and the two prisoners in the northern cells.

collectibles.name: Mission 11: Cloaked in Silence
collectibles.location: Aabe Shifap Ruins.
collectibles.method: Mark Quiet and drop a supply crate directly onto Quiet’s position. Keep Quiet aiming at you from cover so Quiet stays in place. Two hits usually finish the normal fight. Use no bullets against Quiet, then spare Quiet at the final choice; this covers the nonlethal and non-firearm tasks.

collectibles.name: Mission 12: Hellbound
collectibles.location: Afghanistan Central Base Camp.
collectibles.method: Before collecting Emmerich, take the blueprint from a shelf inside the central bunker opposite the bridge. Collect the vertical glamour poster in the garage between Emmerich’s bunker and the western ruined bunker. Subdue the drivers and extract all three Walker Gears. Carry Emmerich to the helicopter without letting Emmerich take damage.

collectibles.name: Mission 13: Pitch Dark
collectibles.location: Bwala ya Masa and Mfinda Oilfield.
collectibles.method: Rescue the four child soldiers at Bwala ya Masa before the children leave; at night the children sleep indoors. Tranquilize and extract the vulture in the burned village on the road to the oilfield. Shut off the transfer pump and destroy the separator tank. For the fast escape task, plant C4 on the separator and leave immediately after detonation, riding out on a Fulton container. On a separate run, stay until the four Walker Gears arrive, subdue their drivers, and extract the gears.

collectibles.name: Mission 14: Lingua Franca
collectibles.location: Kiziba Camp.
collectibles.method: Start at night from the southwestern landing zone. Mark the interpreter and listen from the initial roadside meeting onward. Follow the interpreter to the lone prisoner, then the two prisoners near the central building, and finally the Viscount’s interrogation. Hear each conversation completely before moving. Avoid alerts, discovered bodies, and getting within 30 meters of the Viscount before the Viscount reaches the interrogation room. For the other tasks, rescue the three non-Viscount prisoners, scan the file in the central headquarters, extract a camp materials container, and rescue the Viscount. Do those tasks on a separate run if they disrupt the interrogation route.

collectibles.name: Mission 15: Footprints of Phantoms
collectibles.location: Ditadi Abandoned Village.
collectibles.method: Pick Digitalis (Lutea) at the eastern foot of the large rock above the village. Rescue both prisoners using D-Dog to mark their positions. Extract all four Walker Gears rather than destroying them, and extract the truck at the southwestern road junction.

collectibles.name: Mission 16: Traitors’ Caravan
collectibles.location: Guard Post 14, Nova Braga Airport, Guard Post 12, and Kiziba Camp.
collectibles.method: Read the route file at Guard Post 14, then hurry to the airport. Mark the escort armored vehicle and transport truck. Follow the convoy without alerts and hear the driver’s full conversations at the airport, Guard Post 12, and southeastern Kiziba Camp. After the last conversation, tranquilize the driver, defeat the Skulls, and extract the driver and truck. For the three Zero Risk soldiers, the driver counts as one; collect two more unconscious soldiers by the four-wheel drive at the T-junction between the airport and Guard Post 12.

collectibles.name: Mission 17: Rescue the Intel Agents
collectibles.location: Guard Post 1 and Kiziba Camp.
collectibles.method: Start north of Guard Post 1 and extract the four soldiers leaving its southern end in two four-wheel drives. Extract the transport truck’s driver when the truck arrives. Rescue the escaped agent north of Kiziba before the search catches up. Extract the extra prisoner in the northern camp building and the balaclava-wearing CFA official guarding the prisoner. After extracting an agent, watch the southern headquarters for the second CFA official arriving to investigate. Extract that official before rescuing the remaining agent and leaving.

collectibles.name: Mission 18: Blood Runs Deep
collectibles.location: Guard Posts 9 and 7, Bampeve Plantation, and Kungenga Mine.
collectibles.method: Extract the armored vehicle near Guard Post 9 and both armored vehicles passing Guard Post 7. At Bampeve, extract the former Mbele soldier in a white shirt and blue beret. Extract at least five snipers from the woods southeast of Guard Post 2 and the canyon leading southeast from the mine toward Ngumba. Destroy the gunship. With the child-compatible Fulton upgrade, extract the five children directly from the mine prison before guards discover their escape.

collectibles.name: Mission 19: On the Trail
collectibles.location: Guard Post 16 and the road north toward Guard Post 13.
collectibles.method: Rescue the prisoner in the southeastern building at Guard Post 16. Follow and mark the Major’s subordinate. The Major waits off the east side of the road north of Guard Post 16, on the way toward Guard Post 13. Mark the Major and listen to the entire meeting with the subordinate before subduing and extracting both targets.

collectibles.name: Mission 20: Voices
collectibles.location: Munoko ya Nioka Station, Guard Posts 20 and 17, and Ngumba Industrial Zone.
collectibles.method: Sneak into the truck behind Munoko ya Nioka Station and ride north. At Guard Post 20, scan the route file in the northeastern tent, then reboard the truck. At Guard Post 17, follow the driver to the command tent and hear the conversation about the bodies. Tranquilize and extract an African Wild Dog on the side path above the post. Continue to Shabani. During the Man on Fire fight, drop a water tower onto the boss. Fire at the Floating Boy while the boss is stunned; keep forcing dodges until a shot lands, using the other tower when needed. Then Fulton the stunned Man on Fire and escape.

collectibles.name: Mission 21: The War Economy
collectibles.location: Nova Braga Airport.
collectibles.method: Mark the arms dealer and CFA official. Follow their four conversations without alerts: upstairs in the terminal, at the northern truck hangar, at the southern hangar, then back upstairs in the terminal. Hide in the truck during the hangar visits. After the final conversation, extract both men. Destroy the waiting gunship and pick up its dropped blueprint. Extract the three precious-metal containers in the southern hangar before leaving.

collectibles.name: Mission 22: Retake the Platform
collectibles.location: Mother Base R&D Platform.
collectibles.method: Eliminate the invading commander at the top of the platform. This mission has only the mandatory task.

collectibles.name: Mission 23: The White Mamba
collectibles.location: Guard Post 6 and Bwala ya Masa.
collectibles.method: Extract the eight children at Guard Post 6, then the other 12 children around Masa and the ship. Collect the diamond on the command-tent table at Guard Post 6 and rescue Masa’s prisoner. Before entering the ship, stand on the beach or projecting dock to the north and tranquilize Eli on the ship’s third level with a sniper rifle. Extract Eli without starting the resistance fight.

collectibles.name: Mission 24: Close Contact
collectibles.location: Guard Posts 16 and 20, and Munoko ya Nioka Station.
collectibles.method: Extract the four materials containers at Guard Post 16, then hurry to Guard Post 20 for both engineers and the two arriving four-wheel drives. Extract six Nubian goats from the hills around Guard Post 20. Pick African Peach on the climbable rocks beside the gun emplacement left of Munoko’s northern gate. At the station’s southern entrance, tranquilize and extract a Martial Eagle when a bird lands within reach.

collectibles.name: Mission 25: Aim True, Ye Vengeful
collectibles.location: Guard Post 16 and the pass toward Guard Post 20.
collectibles.method: Rescue the escaped prisoner on the mountain pass before the prisoner reaches the wild dogs. Extract 12 child soldiers around Guard Post 16, saving the red-bereted commander for the vehicle task. Pick the Digitalis (Purpurea) on the plateau west of the post; collect the central cluster until the task checks off. Put the child commander and the tied-up militants’ XO in the same four-wheel drive, then drive both targets out of the hot zone together.

collectibles.name: Mission 26: Hunting Down
collectibles.location: Ditadi Abandoned Village and the route toward Kiziba Camp.
collectibles.method: Scan the route file beneath the communications pavilion on Ditadi’s hill and rescue the village’s four prisoners. Tranquilize and extract a Side-striped Jackal in the grasslands west of Ditadi, around Guard Posts 10, 12, or 14. Intercept the trafficker northwest of Guard Post 14 before the trafficker reaches Kiziba. Extract the trafficker and all five escorts.

collectibles.name: Mission 27: Root Cause
collectibles.location: The road between Guard Posts 7 and 3.
collectibles.method: Drive toward the part of the road closer to Guard Post 7 and intercept the escaped agent’s truck before the crash. Stop the truck, secure the agent, and drive the agent out of the hot zone by land.

collectibles.name: Mission 28: Code Talker
collectibles.location: Lufwa Valley and mansion.
collectibles.method: Defeat and Fulton-extract a sniper Skull; finish all four snipers to make the armored reinforcement appear later. Find Code Talker in the basement reached from the mansion’s northern entrance. Carry Code Talker without letting Code Talker take damage. Extract the armored vehicle blocking the northwestern bridge, then evacuate Code Talker.

collectibles.name: Mission 29: Metallic Archaea
collectibles.location: Nova Braga Airport.
collectibles.method: Avoid being grabbed by any puppet soldier. Climb the ladder behind the hangar ahead of the crash site and attack the four Skulls from the roof. After the Skulls fall, extract a Skull before leaving with Code Talker. If extraction is unavailable on the first run, return after story progress unlocks Skull extraction.

collectibles.name: Mission 30: Skull Face
collectibles.location: OKB Zero.
collectibles.method: Before reaching Skull Face, extract four Walker Gears across the approach and three gates. Extract the three tanks: beyond the first gate, before the third gate, and beyond the third gate. Collect all seven red containers: four beyond the second gate and three beyond the third. Near the helipad, take the smaller stairs down to the service-elevator area and collect the cassette from the player among the construction equipment. Then meet Skull Face.

collectibles.name: Mission 31: Sahelanthropus
collectibles.location: Boss arena.
collectibles.method: Damage the head until the head breaks. When Sahelanthropus leaps toward you late in the fight and slow motion begins, shoot the Floating Boy with a ready primary weapon. Finish destroying Sahelanthropus; use anti-aircraft vehicles and request launcher ammunition as needed.

collectibles.name: Mission 32: To Know Too Much
collectibles.location: Da Shago Kallai, Lamar Khaate Palace, and the CIA agent’s search area.
collectibles.method: Use two runs. On the first, let the search team capture the CIA agent. Rescue the extra prisoners in Da Shago’s headquarters and the palace’s northern prison area. At the palace, extract the driver after the driver delivers the agent. Wait for Miller’s warning about an assassin arriving from Guard Post 12, then intercept and extract that balaclava-wearing soldier before rescuing the agent. On the other run, extract the four search-team soldiers and rescue the agent before discovery.

collectibles.name: Mission 33: Subsistence: C2W
collectibles.location: Da Wialo Kallai and Eastern Communications Post.
collectibles.method: Rescue the two prisoners in the ruined building reached from Da Wialo’s southern entrance. On the southern approach to the communications post, climb the small rock west of the dirt-road bend opposite the Wormwood for the diamonds. Mark the communications dishes before destroying them. Destroy the transmitter inside the building beside the Soviet flag and extract one materials container. This Subsistence version starts without your normal equipment or buddy; take weapons from guards. If no materials container is present, finish other missions before returning so a container can respawn.

collectibles.name: Mission 34: Extreme: Backup, Back Down
collectibles.location: Northern roads, Wakh Sind Barracks, and Lamar Khaate Palace.
collectibles.method: Use separate vehicle and prisoner runs. For vehicles, block the road near the landing zone north of Yakho Oboo with a truck facing south. Stop all seven armored vehicles without resupply or fire support; Fulton at least one. Collect the weapon from the passing transport truck. After all seven are stopped, stay for the reinforcements and extract all three tanks. For prisoners, start south of Guard Post 12 and rescue the nearby wanderer, then stop two armored vehicles to trigger the prisoner transport. Extract the four searching soldiers on the canyon path east of Guard Post 12 and the escaping prisoner ahead of them. Intercept the four-wheel drive carrying a prisoner from Aabe Shifap Ruins toward Wakh Sind. Rescue the prisoner in Wakh Sind’s basement and the prisoner in a cell north of Lamar Khaate Palace. For the final prisoner, follow the river west from the bridge north of Guard Post 12 to the dead end beside the log jam. The Extreme version has stronger enemies. Complete and check these tasks again; the normal mission’s checkmarks do not fill the variant’s list.

collectibles.name: Mission 35: Cursed Legacy
collectibles.location: Lufwa Valley and mansion.
collectibles.method: Southeast of Guard Post 8, search the ground near the circling ravens and wild dogs by the rock face before the bridge for the diamond. Extract the red-bereted ZRS commander from the mansion’s northern room with the communications equipment and scan the file there. If you reload a checkpoint after reading the file, read the file again to restore that task’s completion. Subdue every guard near both containers before extracting either container, so nobody notices the removal. Extract both within the countdown and ride the second container out with its Fulton.

collectibles.name: Mission 36: Total Stealth: Footprints of Phantoms
collectibles.location: Ditadi Abandoned Village.
collectibles.method: Pick Digitalis (Lutea) at the eastern foot of the large rock above the village. Rescue both prisoners using D-Dog to mark their positions. Extract all four Walker Gears rather than destroying them, and extract the truck at the southwestern road junction. Complete this Total Stealth version without being detected.

collectibles.name: Mission 37: Extreme: Traitors’ Caravan
collectibles.location: Guard Post 14, Nova Braga Airport, Guard Post 12, and Kiziba Camp.
collectibles.method: Read the route file at Guard Post 14, then hurry to the airport. Mark the escort armored vehicle and transport truck. Follow the convoy without alerts and hear the driver’s full conversations at the airport, Guard Post 12, and southeastern Kiziba Camp. After the last conversation, tranquilize the driver, defeat the Skulls, and extract the driver and truck. For the three Zero Risk soldiers, the driver counts as one; collect two more unconscious soldiers by the four-wheel drive at the T-junction between the airport and Guard Post 12. The Extreme version has stronger enemies. Complete and check these tasks again; the normal mission’s checkmarks do not fill the variant’s list.

collectibles.name: Mission 38: Extraordinary
collectibles.location: Guard Post 24 and Spugmay Keep.
collectibles.method: Rescue the prisoner in Guard Post 24’s stone building, neutralize all guards at Spugmay, and capture a Griffon Vulture. For the fast film task, use another run and search the three possible film spots immediately: behind the pot near the mortar by the middle arch; the far southwestern arch’s corner; or the inward-facing side of the smallest of three square columns in the southeastern corner. Take the film before reinforcements arrive and leave.

collectibles.name: Mission 39: Total Stealth: Over the Fence
collectibles.location: Wakh Sind Barracks.
collectibles.method: Start east of the barracks and intercept the four-wheel drive arriving from the south; extract the vehicle. Rescue the escaped prisoner behind a rock above the main entrance arch. Collect UN-ARC from the upper-left dormitory in the group of six. Carry the engineer under the basement ceiling hole, put the engineer down, and use a balloon Fulton through the hole rather than the wormhole. Complete this Total Stealth version without being detected.

collectibles.name: Mission 40: Extreme: Cloaked in Silence
collectibles.location: Aabe Shifap Ruins.
collectibles.method: Use supply crates to defeat Quiet without bullets. When a crate is less than 10 meters above Quiet, briefly expose yourself to draw a shot and keep Quiet from dodging. Repeat until Quiet is down, then resolve the final choice. Quiet’s shots can kill immediately, so return to cover at once.

collectibles.name: Mission 41: Proxy War Without End
collectibles.location: Nova Braga Airport and the armored column’s route.
collectibles.method: At the airport, follow the armored column’s commander from the terminal to an office building on the western side. Extract the commander from the second-floor room. At the room’s western exit, count three shelves up from the bottom and take the diamond behind the box. Extract both tanks and both armored vehicles; stay until the remaining vehicle reaches the airport. Destroy the gunship and collect its dropped blueprint before leaving.

collectibles.name: Mission 42: Extreme: Metallic Archaea
collectibles.location: Nova Braga Airport.
collectibles.method: Avoid being grabbed by any puppet soldier. Climb the ladder behind the hangar ahead of the crash site and attack the four Skulls from the roof. After the Skulls fall, extract a Skull before leaving with Code Talker. If extraction is unavailable on the first run, return after story progress unlocks Skull extraction. The Extreme version has stronger enemies. Complete and check these tasks again; the normal mission’s checkmarks do not fill the variant’s list.

collectibles.name: Mission 43: Shining Lights, Even in Death
collectibles.location: Mother Base quarantine platform.
collectibles.method: Identify the sender of the transmission and finish dealing with the infected staff. Both tasks are mandatory story objectives.

collectibles.name: Mission 44: Total Stealth: Pitch Dark
collectibles.location: Bwala ya Masa and Mfinda Oilfield.
collectibles.method: Rescue the four child soldiers at Bwala ya Masa before the children leave; at night the children sleep indoors. Tranquilize and extract the vulture in the burned village on the road to the oilfield. Shut off the transfer pump and destroy the separator tank. For the fast escape task, plant C4 on the separator and leave immediately after detonation, riding out on a Fulton container. On a separate run, stay until the four Walker Gears arrive, subdue their drivers, and extract the gears. Complete this Total Stealth version without being detected. If required containers are missing, complete other missions before returning so the containers respawn.

collectibles.name: Mission 45: A Quiet Exit
collectibles.location: Lamar Khaate Palace and the desert escape.
collectibles.method: For the vehicle task, use the wormhole Fulton to extract all seven tanks and seven armored vehicles. Parasite Armor can protect you while approaching the vehicles; call resupply before armor runs out. Draw enemy fire away from Quiet so Quiet takes no damage. On a separate S-rank attempt, use your strongest launcher instead. After the battle, follow the footprints uphill from the helicopter, past Golden Crescent flowers, and collect Quiet’s tape beneath the trees.

collectibles.name: Mission 46: Truth: The Man Who Sold the World
collectibles.location: Hospital escape.
collectibles.method: Kill all six soldiers in the hospital entrance lobby. When the Man on Fire appears at the exit, land at least 20 shots on the boss before fleeing. Finish the hospital escape.

collectibles.name: Mission 47: Total Stealth: The War Economy
collectibles.location: Nova Braga Airport.
collectibles.method: Mark the arms dealer and CFA official. Follow their four conversations without alerts: upstairs in the terminal, at the northern truck hangar, at the southern hangar, then back upstairs in the terminal. Hide in the truck during the hangar visits. After the final conversation, extract both men. Destroy the waiting gunship and pick up its dropped blueprint. Extract the three precious-metal containers in the southern hangar before leaving. Complete this Total Stealth version without being detected. If required containers are missing, complete other missions before returning so the containers respawn.

collectibles.name: Mission 48: Extreme: Code Talker
collectibles.location: Lufwa Valley and mansion.
collectibles.method: Defeat and Fulton-extract a sniper Skull; finish all four snipers to make the armored reinforcement appear later. Find Code Talker in the basement reached from the mansion’s northern entrance. Carry Code Talker without letting Code Talker take damage. Extract the armored vehicle blocking the northwestern bridge, then evacuate Code Talker. The Extreme version has stronger enemies. Complete and check these tasks again; the normal mission’s checkmarks do not fill the variant’s list.

collectibles.name: Mission 49: Subsistence: Occupation Forces
collectibles.location: Qarya Sakhra Ee and the convoy road toward Da Smasei Laman.
collectibles.method: This Subsistence mission starts without your normal equipment or buddy. Take a guard’s weapon. Interrogate a guard in Qarya Sakhra Ee to mark the deployment plans, then read the plans. Rescue the prisoner in the communications-transmitter room. Fire a warning shot from cover to stop the convoy, then Fulton the colonel’s truck and both tanks before the convoy reaches Da Smasei Laman.

collectibles.name: Mission 50: Extreme: Sahelanthropus
collectibles.location: Boss arena.
collectibles.method: Damage the head until the head breaks. When Sahelanthropus leaps toward you late in the fight and slow motion begins, shoot the Floating Boy with a ready primary weapon. Finish destroying Sahelanthropus; use anti-aircraft vehicles and request launcher ammunition as needed. The Extreme version has stronger enemies. Complete and check these tasks again; the normal mission’s checkmarks do not fill the variant’s list.

achievements.description: Complete all missions with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Earn an S rank on every main mission that has a rank.

steps.text: Replay the ranked missions after developing better gear. Aim for at least @mechanic{130,000 points} on each; Missions 2, 22, and 43 have no rank.
Finish the main objective quickly and skip cutscenes. Leave long optional tasks for a separate run. Avoid retries and alerts where practical; perfect stealth with no kills gives a useful score bonus.
Check equipment and support descriptions for an @warn{A-rank restriction}. Do not use rank-restricting equipment or fire support on S-rank attempts.

Use quick routes for short missions: in Mission 1, rescue Miller and change the extraction point to the northern landing zone near Guard Post 11. In Missions 4 and 33, destroy the Eastern Communications Post radar beforehand, start at its unlocked landing zone, and shoot the three communications dishes with the helicopter’s gun before landing.

For Missions 29 and 42, fight from the airport hangar roof with a strong rifle or launcher. For Missions 31 and 50, use the parked anti-aircraft vehicles and a strong launcher. Keep requesting ammunition as needed.
Check the mission list for missing S ranks, including the prologue and all 12 harder variants. Improve the slowest part of the route on the next attempt.

achievements.summary: Finish any Side Op.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Side Op 1: Extract Interpreter (Russian)} by subduing and extracting the interpreter at @loc{Afghanistan Guard Post 24}.

achievements.summary: Finish all 10 Mine Clearing Side Ops.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Side Ops 83–92}. @npc{D-Dog} can mark the mines. Crouch and approach each mine from behind, then use the pickup prompt to disarm the mine.
If the next Mine Clearing Side Op is absent, advance the story or clear another active Side Op in the same area. Return to the ACC and check again.

achievements.summary: Finish each of the 157 Side Ops at least once.

steps.text: Work through unchecked entries in the @mechanic{Side Ops} list as the story advances. Completed operations can reappear; use the completion checkmarks to avoid repeating them unnecessarily.
When an operation is missing, finish active operations occupying its area, return to the ACC, and check again. Finish the yellow story operations and Missions 45 and 46 to open the remaining entries.
Complete @mechanic{Side Ops 107–109} to unlock weapon customization. Finish the legendary animal and wandering soldier chains as they appear; these also advance the animal and photo collections.
Complete @mechanic{Side Ops 151–157}, the Mother Base target practices. Each requires 35 targets within 5 minutes. Night-vision goggles highlight targets; follow the R&D route below for Side Op 152.
For @mechanic{Side Op 152: R&D target practice}, begin by shooting the target ahead and the target behind your starting position. The following route covers all 35 targets.
Move onto the helipad. Shoot the six targets around the stairs, then look over the helipad’s left edge for two targets below. Stay behind the railing to avoid falling.
Cross the helipad and shoot the target hidden behind the stairs on the far side.
Leave the helipad by the stairs on the left. From the foot of those stairs, shoot the two targets among the helipad supports.
Return to the Side Op’s starting point and vault the railing onto the deck below. Shoot the two targets on that deck, then look over its right-hand railing for a third.
Turn around and take the left-hand stairs beside the way back to the starting point. Shoot two targets ahead and one below.
Go upstairs again, turn left, and descend the next staircase. Shoot the two targets beyond the railing on the lower level.
Follow that level to the wall recess. Shoot both targets inside the recess.
Return toward the staircase. From the railing, shoot the single target on the floor below.
Return to the helipad and descend the staircase that had the target behind it. Continue down several floors; shoot two targets ahead and one down on the ground.
Climb back up two floors and follow the corridor. Vault the railing onto the ventilation duct, then follow the duct and shoot four targets along the way.
Drop off the duct, turn right, then turn left into the structure’s interior. Shoot the two targets against the wall.
Descend to ground level and circle the platform to shoot the last two targets. The counter must reach @mechanic{35/35} before the five-minute timer expires.

achievements.description: Capture an outpost or guard post.
achievements.summary: Clear every enemy from one outpost or guard post.

steps.text: At any @loc{guard post}, knock out or kill every soldier until the game confirms that the post is captured.

achievements.summary: Successfully complete all 20 key Combat Deployment missions.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Missions → Combat Deployment} and send a team on the dispatch marked with a yellow circle. Complete each key dispatch to reveal the next; retry failures.

Continue the story through Mission 31, then finish Mission 32 and let @item{Battle Gear} finish development. The late dispatches also need tanks, armored vehicles, or Walker Gears; extract those vehicles before dispatching the team.
Improve your Combat Unit to raise success chances. Farm Walker Gears in @mechanic{Mission 15: Footprints of Phantoms} if you run short.

Finish the chain through @mechanic{Prevent the Coup d’état}. The complete key-dispatch sequence is: Break through the Blockade Force; Restore the DMZ; Recapture the Coltan Mine; Search and Destroy Remaining Forces; Break Through the Cordon; Liberate the Tanker; Presidential Escort; Assist the Civilian Evacuation; Defend the Refugee Camp; Destroy the New Fighter Aircraft; Repel the Border Forces; Recapture the Port Facilities; Destroy the Uranium Centrifuges; Crush the Drug Cartel; Defend the Pipeline; Rescue the Peacekeepers; Eliminate the Dictator; Recapture the Oilfield Facility; Secure the Bridgeheads; Prevent the Coup d’état.

achievements.summary: Deploy on an infiltration mission against another player’s FOB.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Mission 22: Retake the Platform}, connect to the online service, and create your first @mechanic{FOB} when prompted.
Open @mechanic{Missions → FOB Missions}, select another player’s base, and launch an infiltration. Deployment is enough; winning the infiltration is unnecessary.

achievements.summary: Unlock D-Dog as a deployable buddy.

steps.text: Start Mission 4 at the southern @loc{Eastern Communications Post} landing zone and listen for a barking puppy. Find @npc{D-Dog} nearby and Fulton-extract the puppy.
Return to @loc{Mother Base} to see the puppy scene. Continue main missions and revisit the base until D-Dog’s grown-up scene plays and D-Dog appears in the buddy list.

achievements.summary: Unlock Quiet as a deployable buddy.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Quiet} in @mechanic{Mission 11: Cloaked in Silence} and spare Quiet at the final choice. If Quiet was killed, replay Mission 11 and spare Quiet.
After Mission 14, complete @mechanic{Side Op 111: Visit Quiet}. At the @loc{Medical Platform}, take the stairs down from the helipad to Quiet’s cell.
Call the helicopter and leave the platform to trigger the scene that adds Quiet to the buddy list.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum bond with D-Horse.

steps.text: Ride @npc{D-Horse} during missions and travel between Side Ops until the bond meter is full.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum bond with D-Dog.

steps.text: Take @npc{D-Dog} on main missions and Side Ops until the bond meter reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum bond with Quiet.

steps.text: Take @npc{Quiet} on main missions and Side Ops until the bond meter reaches its maximum.
Use the iDroid map to assign Quiet scouting and sniping positions. Finish this bond before Side Op 150; if Quiet has left, complete Mission 11 seven times while sparing Quiet to restore the buddy.

achievements.summary: Successfully Fulton-extract an enemy soldier.

steps.text: After the Fulton tutorial in @mechanic{Mission 2}, knock out an enemy soldier outdoors. Attach a @item{Fulton} and let the extraction succeed.

achievements.summary: Question an enemy soldier during a CQC hold.

steps.text: Extract the Russian interpreter in @mechanic{Side Op 1}. In @loc{Afghanistan}, grab a Russian-speaking enemy soldier from behind and use the interrogation controls to ask a question.

achievements.summary: Rescue a female prisoner by extracting her.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Side Op 28: Prisoner Extraction 02} at @loc{Da Shago Kallai}. Interrogate a guard to mark the prisoner, then extract the woman.

achievements.description: Increase Mother Base staff to 50 or more personnel.
achievements.summary: Have at least 50 staff members at Mother Base.

steps.text: Recruit soldiers with @item{Fulton} extractions and accept mission volunteers until your staff reaches 50. Expand platforms when staff capacity fills.

achievements.description: Increase Mother Base staff to 250 or more personnel.
achievements.summary: Have at least 250 staff members at Mother Base.

steps.text: Recruit soldiers with @item{Fulton} extractions and accept mission volunteers until your staff reaches 250. Expand platforms when staff capacity fills.

achievements.summary: Raise every Mother Base team and unit to level 50 or higher.

steps.text: Expand Mother Base and recruit soldiers with strong skills. Use @mechanic{Staff Management} to put each soldier in the team matching the soldier’s best skill.
Bring every team to level 50, including the @mechanic{Security Team} unlocked with FOBs. Replace low-skill staff with better recruits when a team reaches its capacity.

achievements.summary: Finish developing 50 different weapons and equipment items.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Mother Base → Development} to develop new weapons and equipment until 50 entries are complete. Start with inexpensive entries and improve team levels to unlock more options.

achievements.summary: Finish developing 100 different weapons and equipment items.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Mother Base → Development} to develop new weapons and equipment until 100 entries are complete. Start with inexpensive entries and improve team levels to unlock more options.

achievements.summary: Finish developing 300 different weapons and equipment items.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Mother Base → Development} to develop new weapons and equipment until 300 entries are complete. Start with inexpensive entries and improve team levels to unlock more options.

achievements.description: Construct all available platforms for Mother Base.
achievements.summary: Finish all four platform levels in every Mother Base platform category.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Mother Base → Base Facilities} and complete every expansion for Command, Combat, R&D, Base Development, Support, Intel, and Medical.
Bring each of the seven categories to level 4, for 28 platforms in total. Extract resource containers to fund the later expansions; FOB construction does not count.

achievements.summary: Finish developing a nuclear weapon.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Mission 31}. Reserve @item{75,000 processed Fuel Resources}, @item{50,000 processed Minor Metal}, and @item{750,000 GMP}. Earn the Hero achievement before starting nuclear development.
Open @mechanic{Mother Base → Resources → Nuclear Weapons} and start development. Check the displayed completion timer rather than assuming a fixed duration.
For online development, set a reminder to return before the timer ends. Offline development advances only while the game runs.
Let development finish. Keep another @item{100,000 GMP} ready and dispose of the weapon immediately for Disarmament before an online weapon can be stolen.

achievements.description: Dispose of a nuclear weapon in your possession.
achievements.summary: Dispose of a nuclear weapon in your possession.

steps.text: Have a completed @item{Nuclear Weapon} and @item{100,000 GMP}. In @mechanic{Mother Base → Resources}, open the nuclear weapon category and select the @mechanic{Nuclear Waste} disposal option.
Confirm disposal. If the weapon was built online, stay connected to access the online inventory; dispose of the weapon before another player steals it.

achievements.description: Earn a total of 10,000,000 GMP or more.
achievements.summary: Earn at least 10,000,000 GMP in total.

steps.text: Keep earning GMP through missions, Side Ops, dispatches, and diamonds. Spending GMP does not erase progress toward the lifetime total.

achievements.summary: Collect all 11 memento photos.

steps.text: Finish the @mechanic{Extract the Wandering Mother Base Soldiers} chain, Side Ops 51–60, to collect the first 10 photos. Approach each soldier while crouched under a cardboard box to make the soldier surrender.

Visit @npc{Paz} behind the blue-lit door above the @loc{Medical Platform} helipad. Give Paz one photo per visit. Pass a day with a Phantom Cigar between visits; return to the ACC and fly back if Paz remains asleep.
After handing over all 10 photos, return for the next scene. Collect the final photo from the wall outside Paz’s room, beside the exit door.

achievements.summary: Earn the Hero codename by reaching 150,000 Heroism after Mission 31.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Mission 31: Sahelanthropus}, then keep completing missions and rescuing prisoners or animals until Heroism reaches @mechanic{150,000}.
Delay nuclear development until this achievement unlocks; starting a nuclear weapon removes @warn{50,000 Heroism}.
